# @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab 0.6.7

Native TaskManagerPage observer-loop fix release for DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`.

## Changed

- The plugin no longer registers its own `main:schedules` page. DSH's shipped `TaskManagerPage` owns task selection, Rules, Delivery records, editing, validation, deletion, and the inline right detail column.
- The plugin now acts as an enhancer: it keeps the sidebar summary and delivery popup, adds attention dots to native task rows, and adds counts to native All / Active / Inactive filters.

- Edit no longer switches the main panel to the source conversation when a right Sidebar is already mounted; it opens DSH's native `scheduleTask` page in-place.
- The separate History action is restored and selects the native `Delivery records` tab using DSH's stable `data-detail-tab="records"` marker.

- The custom inline Rules/Delivery records editor is no longer reachable from Automation tasks. Task cards now hand off to DSH's native `scheduleTask` page, including the shipped date/time pickers, validation, history, and save flow.
- The redundant History row action was removed because the native task page already owns both Rules and Delivery records tabs.

- Replaced the one-second whole-panel interval with an adaptive clock and memoized sorting, filtering, and grouping.
- Notifications now distinguish task discovery from delivery discovery, so recurring tasks become unread again when a new result arrives.
- Native DSH Session status now stays authoritative: unread deliveries no longer recolor the Session schedule clock. Only an actually overdue active task adds the warning color.
- Automation-task cards now use a compact attention dot: business color for a new saved delivery and warning color for overdue.
- New deliveries raise a native `shell.overlay` Toast with an Open conversation action. The package now explicitly injects the DSH UI layout that owns `shell.overlay`.
- Popup notification state is now separate from seen state: a native toast is emitted once per unread delivery, while the card indicator persists until the source conversation is actually opened.
- Rules and Delivery records are metadata views and no longer acknowledge the delivery.
- The delivery toast reads the authoritative catalog directly from the mounted `shell.overlay`; an adaptive refresh fallback checks near due times in case an invalidation is delayed.
- Delivery receipts are intentionally not labelled success/failure because DSH Schedule records inbox delivery, not model execution outcome.
- Automation tasks keeps its overdue warning independently from unread/seen state.
- Migrates legacy `seen-v1` state without replaying already-seen deliveries.
- Split the browser client into maintainable `src/client/*` fragments with a deterministic zero-dependency build check.
- Added Russian UI strings.
- Renamed the misleading “New reminder” action to “New conversation” and explains that it starts a chat where DSH can create an automation.
- Separated the keyboard-activatable task body from edit/history/delete buttons for cleaner accessibility semantics.

## Tests

- Added DST/time-zone, cron/interval validation, notification migration, recurring-delivery, catalog race, and update-conflict coverage.
- CI verifies that committed `lib/client.js` exactly matches `src/client/*`.
